_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Written Course of Instruction (COI) for Key Personnel
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for a written course of instruction used to prepare and validate criterion referenced training that certifies COMSEC Maintenance Technicians.
use_relationship:
The written course of instruction shall be used to prepare instructions to present training course that certify COMSEC Maintenance Technicians.  The contractor presentation of the course will be used to validate the training course of instruction.  The training will be prepared as a criterion referenced training.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract and NSA Performance Guide 62-7, entire content.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Document
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein.  The NSA Performance Guide 62-7, the current edition, and NSA Addendum to NSA Performance Guide 62-7, current edition, is located at the National Security Agency, Information Assurance Directorate, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6718, Attn: I5222, IA Logistics Support.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: Data prepared shall be delivered in accordance with NSA Performance Guide 62-7, for the Preparation of Criterion Referenced Training Course of Instruction.  When preparing a Software Maintenance Course of Instruction to support INFOSEC equipment/systems, the use of the NSA Addendum to NSA Performance Guide 62-7, shall be considered.
